title: ENFR: Evidence Networks with Flow-Matched References for Amortized Simulation-Based Model Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.23825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The evidence, $\mathcal{Z} = p(x | \mathcal{M})$, of a data-generating model $\mathcal{M}$ is a powerful tool in Bayesian frameworks: it enables model inference, model misspecification tests, and goodness-of-fit assessment as an alternative to standard discrepancy statistics, e.g. $\chi^2$. While versatile, the evidence is notoriously difficult to compute, even when the likelihood is available. In both likelihood-based and simulation-based inference, estimating $\mathcal{Z}$ provides an immediate solution to high-dimensional goodness-of-fit or model misspecification tests: using $\mathcal{Z}(x)$ as the test statistic induces a minimum-volume level-$\alpha$ test. Such tests are essential to assess model fidelity, which is necessary to trust simulation-based parameter inference. translated_title: ENFR：基于流匹配参考的证据网络用于摊销式基于仿真的模型推断
translated_abstract: 证据 $\mathcal{Z} = p(x | \mathcal{M})$，即数据生成模型 $\mathcal{M}$ 的证据，是贝叶斯框架中的一个强大工具：它能够实现模型推断、模型误设检验和拟合优度评估，可作为标准差异统计量（如 $\chi^2$）的替代方案。尽管用途广泛，证据的计算却是出了名的困难，即使似然函数可用时也是如此。无论是在基于似然的推断还是基于仿真的推断中，估计 $\mathcal{Z}$ 都能为高维拟合优度检验或模型误设检验提供直接的解决方案：使用 $\mathcal{Z}(x)$ 作为检验统计量可诱导出最小体积的 $\alpha$ 水平检验。此类检验对于评估模型保真度至关重要，而模型保真度是信任基于仿真的参数推断的必要条件。现有的学习方法主要针对贝叶斯因子，而贝叶斯因子只能衡量证据的比值。与之相反，我们提供了对……的准确、快速且摊销式的估计（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ENFR方法，通过结合证据网络与流匹配参考技术，实现对贝叶斯证据的准确、快速且摊销式的估计，从而突破仅衡量证据比值的贝叶斯因子方法的局限，为高维拟合优度检验和模型误设检验提供直接解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ENFR, which combines evidence networks with flow-matched references to provide accurate, fast, and amortized estimates of the Bayesian evidence, going beyond Bayes factor approaches that only measure evidence ratios and enabling direct high-dimensional goodness-of-fit and model misspecification tests.
